scope: Independent vectorized arithmetic from original frozen labels,predictions and states; no fit or model import. Includes source-group bias+centered MSE and adjustment energy/alignment identities, counts, every repeat/support/selection row and normalized missingness.
limitations: Descriptive weighted identities do not establish causal sources of failure.
Repeated labels may reflect conditions or annotation differences, not proven biological noise.
Coordinatewise feature bounds are not joint support tests or evidence that extrapolation caused error.
